jobs.title: Director of Product Management – Open USD
jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Job Description: Director of Product Management – Open USD Compliance and Onboarding Feature Owner
Visa’s Stablecoin team is building cutting-edge onchain infrastructure to change the way money moves. While onchain solutions began as niche and speculative, they are now transforming how value moves across the global financial ecosystem.
Visa is at the forefront of this transition. We are rapidly expanding our stablecoin and tokenized money infrastructure to enhance our network and develop solutions for partners around the world. Visa brings trust, scale, and security to the evolving onchain ecosystem, creating the opportunity for generational impact in payments and beyond.
We are seeking a Director of Product Management – Open USD Compliance and Onboarding to set the strategy and lead delivery of scalable capabilities for partner onboarding, Know Your Business (KYB), compliance, and partner data management. This leader will define the global product vision and operating model, establish roadmap priorities, and guide the development of workflows, platforms, controls, and automation required to expand Open USD responsibly across markets and partner segments.
This is a senior, highly cross-functional leadership role at the intersection of stablecoins, regulatory strategy, financial crime compliance, onboarding operations, data governance, and enterprise-scale financial infrastructure. The ideal candidate combines strategic product leadership with strong execution discipline, can influence executive stakeholders, and can translate complex global and local requirements into a cohesive platform strategy and measurable business outcomes.
In this role, you will lead across compliance, legal, risk, operations, engineering, data, sales, client-facing teams, and regional stakeholders to define and deliver the capabilities required to scale Open USD globally. You will own the compliance and onboarding product portfolio, including regional expansion of KYB and related controls based on local regulatory, licensing, data, documentation, and risk requirements. You will align global platform standards with market-specific needs while avoiding unnecessary fragmentation.
This role requires an enterprise product leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, make informed trade-offs across growth, risk, control, and client experience, and mobilize cross-functional teams to deliver capabilities that are controlled, auditable, scalable, and commercially practical. The Director will establish governance, communicate decisions and dependencies to senior leadership, and ensure the portfolio is positioned for sustainable global growth.
This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
Responsibilities
As the Director of Product Management – Open USD Compliance and Onboarding , you will:
- Set the global product strategy and multi-year roadmap for Open USD compliance, KYB, onboarding, and partner data capabilities , aligning platform investments with business growth, risk appetite, regulatory obligations, and client needs.
- Lead expansion of compliance and KYB capabilities into new regions by partnering with regional compliance, legal, risk, and business leaders to assess local requirements and translate them into scalable product configurations, controls, data models, and operating procedures.
- Establish a global-to-local product framework that preserves consistent enterprise standards while supporting jurisdiction-specific requirements for entity verification, beneficial ownership, documentation, screening, approvals, data residency, retention, auditability, and ongoing monitoring.
- Own the compliance and onboarding product portfolio , including intake, identity and business verification, case management, approval routing, partner readiness, remediation, periodic review, and lifecycle data management.
- Drive automation and operating-model transformation , replacing manual and fragmented processes with reusable platform services, configurable workflows, decisioning, integrations, and measurable controls.
- Direct market-entry readiness for new regions and partner segments , defining product gaps, regulatory dependencies, launch criteria, sequencing, investment needs, and escalation paths in partnership with regional stakeholders.
- Provide executive leadership across product, technology, compliance, legal, risk, operations, data, sales, and client services , creating shared accountability for roadmap decisions, delivery milestones, control effectiveness, and commercial outcomes.
- Guide engineering and data architecture priorities for onboarding automation, KYB orchestration, third-party integrations, data governance, system-of-record strategy, access controls, observability, resilience, and operational scale.
- Define portfolio governance and decision forums for prioritization, funding, risk acceptance, regulatory change intake, market exceptions, and cross-functional dependency management.
- Develop and maintain a capability model for regional compliance requirements , identifying what can be standardized globally, configured by market, or delivered through local integrations and operational processes.
- Own product outcomes and performance , including onboarding cycle time, KYB completion and approval rates, automation adoption, data quality, control effectiveness, issue reduction, regional launch readiness, client experience, and operating efficiency.
- Represent the portfolio with senior executives and governance bodies , providing clear recommendations on investment, risk, launch readiness, regulatory dependencies, operational capacity, and scaling opportunities.
- Build and develop a high-performing product organization , setting clear direction, coaching product managers and cross-functional leads, strengthening product management discipline, and fostering accountability for end-to-end outcomes.
- Shape the future operating model for Open USD compliance and onboarding , including organizational roles, platform ownership, regional engagement, controls, service levels, vendor strategy, escalation paths, and continuous improvement priorities.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree, OR 13+ years of relevant work experience..

Preferred Qualifications

- 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD
- Extensive experience leading digital product portfolios, platform strategies, and multi-year roadmaps in complex, global organizations.
- Demonstrated experience developing compliance, KYB, onboarding, financial crime, identity, risk, or regulated financial-services products at scale.
- Experience expanding products into new countries or regions and translating local regulatory, licensing, documentation, beneficial ownership, screening, privacy, data residency, and record-retention requirements into scalable capabilities.
- Deep knowledge of the cryptocurrency and stablecoin ecosystem, including permissionless blockchain technology, wallets, tokenized money, and the roles of issuers, financial institutions, infrastructure providers, and regulators.
- Strong understanding of banking and payment systems, including cross-border money movement, authorization, clearing, settlement, treasury, liquidity, and financial crime controls.
- Proven ability to influence executives, secure alignment across functions and regions, and make balanced decisions across growth, client experience, technology, operations, compliance, and risk.
- Experience leading cross-functional portfolios through strategy, funding, requirements, architecture, delivery, launch readiness, adoption, and ongoing performance management.
- Strong command of product management and agile delivery practices, including outcome-based roadmaps, portfolio prioritization, requirements decomposition, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release governance.
- Ability to establish governance, operating models, decision rights, escalation mechanisms, and measurable controls for globally distributed products and teams.
- Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare compelling executive presentations, investment recommendations, product narratives, and regulatory or governance updates.
- Experience developing product talent, coaching teams, and leading through influence across technical and non-technical organizations.
- Ability to work across multiple time zones, support emerging global opportunities, and travel as needed.
- Proficiency with product planning, requirements, workflow, documentation, API testing, and release-management tools such as Jira Align, Jira, process-mapping tools, and Postman or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience leading global products across payments, money movement, treasury, settlement, digital assets, stablecoins, blockchain infrastructure, wallets, or tokenized money.
- Experience designing configurable KYB, onboarding, case-management, screening, or compliance platforms that support multiple jurisdictions and risk tiers.
- Experience partnering directly with regional compliance, regulatory, legal, privacy, information security, financial crime, and government-engagement teams on market entry or product expansion.
- Experience with developer portals, OpenAPI specifications, Postman collections, SDKs, sandbox environments, API analytics, observability, or client integration tooling.
- Experience designing scalable implementation methodologies, certification processes, partner onboarding models, vendor strategies, or tiered technical and operational support models.
- Familiarity with regulatory change management, control testing, model or rules governance, audit support, and issue remediation in a global regulated environment.

Information for US Applicants
For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $203,800.00 to $ 326,100.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.
Work Hours
Varies upon the needs of the department.

Travel Requirements
This position requires travel 5-10% of the time.

Mental/Physical Requirements
This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law, including the requirements of Article 49 of the San Francisco Police Code.

jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

With data being the fuel that drives our future, our strategies, policies, and business successes around data will define Visa's future growth. Unlocking value through trusted, innovative use of data on behalf of consumers, businesses, and communities is central to our success. Guided by Visa's Data Values and commitment to the responsible use of data, the  Global Data Office (GDO)  is leading the evolution of Visa's enterprise data capabilities to accelerate business growth and innovation.

Led by Visa's Chief Data Officer, the Global Data Office drives high-impact, enterprise-wide initiatives spanning data strategy, critical investments, platform modernization, and marketplace execution. Working closely with technology, product, operations, and business teams across Visa's global organization, GDO is focused on building scalable data products and platforms that enable trusted, actionable, and reusable data assets across the enterprise.

We are seeking a Product Manager to support Visa's Master Data Platform within the Global Data Office. This role will be responsible for driving the vision, roadmap, and delivery of platform capabilities that enable consistent, trusted, and scalable master data across Visa. The Product Manager will partner closely with engineering, architecture, business stakeholders, and regional teams to deliver data products that improve operational efficiency, support business growth, and enhance data accessibility across the enterprise.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to leverage emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to improve product development, requirements management, stakeholder engagement, and operational effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities
- Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for Master Data Platform capabilities, aligning investments with business priorities and customer needs.

- Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into well-defined product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.

- Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing business value, customer needs, technical dependencies, and platform scalability.

- Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design and deliver capabilities supporting master data creation, matching, enrichment, management, and consumption.

- Define API, integration, and data service requirements, including support for developer-facing documentation and Swagger specifications.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams across product, technology, operations, and regional business organizations to ensure successful delivery and adoption of platform capabilities.

- Drive Agile product development processes, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, release planning, testing, and production readiness activities.

- Establish product success metrics and monitor platform adoption, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

- Communicate product vision, roadmap progress, priorities, and delivery outcomes to leadership and key stakeholders.

- Support product launches, onboarding activities, change management, and continuous improvement initiatives across global teams.

- Evaluate emerging technologies, market trends, and user feedback to identify opportunities for innovation and enhance platform capabilities.

- Build strong partnerships and influence decision-making across multiple organizations to achieve alignment and successful execution.

This is a hybrid position. Visa requires a minimum of three days in the office each week. Expectations for in-office days will be confirmed by the hiring manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications
- 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications
- 6+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree, OR 4+ years with an Advanced Degree, OR up to 3 years with a PhD.

- Experience in product management, business analysis, data management, or platform delivery within a technology, data, payments, or financial services environment.

- Experience translating business needs into product requirements, user stories, and roadmap priorities.

- Experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Data Product Manager supporting master data, reference data, metadata, governance, or data platform initiatives.

- Strong understanding of Master Data Management (MDM), data governance, data quality, metadata management, and data lifecycle principles.

- Experience defining and executing product roadmaps for enterprise data platforms serving multiple business domains and stakeholders.

- Knowledge of payment processing, financial services, risk, merchant, customer, or reference data domains is highly desirable.

- Experience gathering requirements and translating complex business and regulatory needs into scalable platform capabilities and product features.

- Proven ability to prioritize competing demands and manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess business impact, identify root causes, and drive data-informed decisions.

- Experience working with APIs, data services, event-driven architectures, and associated documentation tools such as Swagger/OpenAPI.

- Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, architecture, governance, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver product outcomes.

- Experience defining product KPIs, adoption metrics, data quality measures, and success criteria for platform capabilities.

- Strong written, verbal, and executive communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, drive alignment, and make decisions with limited information and evolving requirements.

- Experience supporting Agile product development practices, including backlog management, sprint planning, feature prioritization, and release management.

Product Manager - Job Description and Responsibilities

Job Description
Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.
The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to transforming and automating business processes across the end-to-end client service journey, making client and employee interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. As a member of the Digital and AI team, you will play a pivotal role in driving process improvement, automation, and digitization across Client Services, spanning onboarding, implementation, configuration, testing, licensing, service delivery, issue resolution, and optimization processes.
We are seeking a Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of high-impact digital, AI, and automation products that improve processes across Client Services. This role will identify and prioritize opportunities, translate complex user and business needs into scalable product capabilities, guide technical solutioning, align cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
The ideal candidate is a skilled product manager with deep product management experience, strong technical fluency, and demonstrated success applying rigorous critical thinking to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems. They have experience building and scaling AI-enabled products from discovery and prototyping through production, adoption, and continuous improvement. They will contribute to shaping the future of Client Services platforms and solutions, ensuring exceptional client and employee experiences, operational efficiency, responsible AI outcomes, resilient operations, and seamless integration with Visa systems.
Responsibilities
• Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for high-impact digital, AI, and automation products across a defined product area or process domain within Client Services, including discovery, user research, business-case development, requirements definition, prioritization, responsible AI and risk controls, experimentation, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
• Drive cross-functional collaboration across business, product, technology, operations, design, data science, risk, legal, compliance, and regional teams; influence stakeholders and resolve trade-offs to maintain delivery momentum.
• Develop fluency in the payments ecosystem and Client Services capabilities, workflows, systems, data, controls, and operational dependencies to inform product strategy and execution across multiple process areas.
• Define measurable product outcomes and KPIs; monitor adoption, user experience, operational performance, model quality, risk, and value realization; and use data and feedback to guide prioritization and investment decisions.
• Apply rigorous critical thinking and systems thinking to ambiguous, complex, and multi-dependency Client Services challenges: frame problems, test assumptions, synthesize qualitative and quantitative evidence, evaluate alternatives and risks, make sound product decisions, and clearly articulate the rationale and expected business impact.
• Lead the development of AI-enabled products in partnership with engineering and data science, including use-case selection, rapid prototyping, data and model readiness, evaluation criteria, human oversight, privacy and security controls, production deployment, observability, and ongoing performance monitoring.
• Shape and deliver incident-management platform capabilities and workflow solutions that improve detection, intake, triage, escalation, collaboration, resolution, communications, reporting, and post-incident learning across Client Services.
• Communicate product strategy, investment rationale, delivery status, risks, dependencies, and performance insights to senior stakeholders and leadership, escalating to executive sponsors as needed.

5 or more years of relevant product management experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 3 or more years with an Advanced Degree (e.g., MBA, MS), including end-to-end ownership of complex digital, platform, automation, or AI-enabled products from discovery through launch and optimization.
• Required: Demonstrated critical-thinking, analytical judgment, and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently frame ambiguous business problems, challenge assumptions, evaluate qualitative and quantitative evidence, assess options and risks, and translate insights into product strategy, decisions, and clear requirements.
• Required: Demonstrated experience using AI technologies to build products, including identifying viable use cases, creating or directing prototypes, defining data and model requirements, establishing evaluation and success metrics, partnering with engineering and data science to productionize solutions, and applying responsible AI, privacy, security, and human-oversight practices. Experience with generative AI and/or agentic AI is required.
• Required: Experience using or building incident-management platforms and solutions, including defining workflows, product requirements, integrations, service-level measures, dashboards, and capabilities supporting incident intake, triage, escalation, resolution, communication, and post-incident improvement.
Preferred Qualifications:
7 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 4 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD
• Proven experience owning complex enterprise software, workflow, platform, automation, or AI products with multiple integrations, stakeholder groups, and operational dependencies.
• Strong technical acumen across enterprise systems, APIs, data architecture, cloud services, AI/ML concepts, model evaluation, and production monitoring, with the ability to make informed feasibility and trade-off decisions.
• Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way
• Strategic mindset with systems thinking, strong product judgment, and the ability to balance client value, operational impact, technical feasibility, risk, and investment trade-offs.
• Knowledge of payment systems (e.g. card networks, ACH) and banking
• Strong product execution and program leadership skills, with a record of delivering complex, multi-team, multi-region, and multi-dependency initiatives and managing risks, milestones, and value realization.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
• Ability to influence, negotiate, and drive results in complex, multi-dependency environments, ensuring that timelines are adhered to and any risks to the project are called out early.

- Experience in product management, product ownership, business process analysis, or sales operations.

jobs.title: Director, Customer Journey Activation Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Customer Journey Business Product team is a cross-functional organization responsible for driving product strategy and execution across the end-to-end customer journey from demand generation through sales, implementation, servicing, and growth. Our team operates as a true enterprise product organization, partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, Operations, Finance, Support, and Technology to design and scale capabilities that work consistently across Visa. Product leaders on this team own outcomes across the lifecycle, not just individual tools, and play a critical role in shaping how work scales across regions, value streams, and customer motions.

We are seeking a Director, Implementation & Activation Product Management to lead the product strategy for the post-sales customer experience, with a focus on implementation, onboarding, activation, and transition to ongoing customer success. This role will serve as the connective point between the seller and Customer Success teams, bringing together the systems, workflows, data, and governance needed to create a more seamless and connected post-sales journey. The leader in this role will be critical to driving revenue outcomes by improving time-to-value, activation, adoption, implementation efficiency, and visibility into post-sale performance.

Key Responsibilities:
- Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Implementation / Activation value stream across the sales to post-sales customer journey.
- Design and scale a connected implementation and activation experience from deal through onboarding, go-live, early usage, and handoff to Customer Success.
- Bridge Sales, CS, Implementation, Finance, and Technology teams to align process, roles, systems, and customer milestones.
- Define the business architecture and workflow model that connects seller commitments, implementation readiness, customer onboarding steps, activation milestones, and ongoing success management.
- Drive platform and process improvements across CRM, onboarding, implementation, workflow, case management, customer communications, and reporting tools to reduce friction in the post-sale journey.
- Partner operations and customer-facing leaders to ensure implementation and activation motions support revenue targets, forecast accuracy, customer retention, and expansion readiness.
- Establish and monitor OKRs such as implementation cycle time, time-to-value, activation rate, onboarding completion, feature adoption, customer satisfaction, and post-sale revenue realization.
- Translate customer, seller, and operational pain points into prioritized product requirements, business cases, and delivery plans.
- Lead cross-functional governance for post-sales process standardization, while balancing enterprise consistency with regional and segment needs.
- Drive change management, field enablement, and adoption for new implementation and activation capabilities, workflows, and operating models.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:
- 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 10 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters/MBA /JD/MD), or a minimum of 5 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:
- 15 or more years of experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 12 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, or MD), PhD with 9+ years of experience
- 8+ years of experience in product management, revenue operations, customer success operations, implementation, or related enterprise workflow roles.
- Proven experience working across post-sales journeys, including onboarding, implementation, activation, customer handoff, or service delivery.
- Experience building or scaling operational processes and product capabilities that improve time-to-value, adoption, and customer outcomes.
- Strong understanding of how post-sales execution connects to revenue realization, retention, and long-term customer growth.
- Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Support, Finance, and Technology.
- Experience with enterprise platforms such as CRM, workflow, case management, customer success, implementation, or analytics tools.

Key Skills:
- Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect customer experience, operating processes, and revenue outcomes.
- Deep understanding of implementation, onboarding, activation, and customer transition workflows.
- Strong analytical and operational skills, with the ability to turn data into actions and investment priorities.
- Product leadership mindset with experience defining roadmaps, prioritizing across stakeholders, and driving adoption at scale.
- Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills in complex, matrixed environments.
